Review changes to PR #115 from Jack Heart, 2026-11-14. Make them in this PR. (1) "Checkpoint ref and checkpoint ID seem redundant. Why should you have to do both?" CheckpointRef currently carries a key string built by checkpoint_id(...), plus policy: PolicyKey and line, which state experiment/job/seed/role three ways. Make the policy key the one owner. A ref is built from its parts and its key is derived (a property computed from policy + name; never written by hand). checkpoint_id stops being public API. line is derived from the policy unless the checkpoint has no Etude run. An outside file is CheckpointRef(address="hf://...", artifact=...). (2) Jack Heart: "we could also consider just taking the arguments of PolicyKey and CheckpointRef too so that you don't have to explicitly cast twice". So the constructor takes the policy key's fields flat, with PolicyKey's defaults: CheckpointRef(experiment="ppo", job="base", seed=1, name="updates-500.pt", artifact=saved). It stores a PolicyKey internally and exposes it as .policy. Holding a key: key.checkpoint(name=..., artifact=...). Do not also accept policy= on the constructor (one spelling). (3) "players=(direct, Final(experiment="tla-frontier", job="small", inference=direct)) why is there an inference variable on a player argument?" A relative seat's inference= becomes optional, defaulting to how the seating's held checkpoint plays; give it only to compare different play. Do not rename Inference here; EXP-73 settles that name. Update docs, release notes and tests to match. Old stored keys stay readable.
